g.text: Miata NA hardware - TH PCB (owner-fitted TH, JLC SMD)

g.desc: Miata NA hardware - TH PCB (owner-fitted TH, JLC SMD)

g.text: Embedded symbols (lib PERF); generated by scripts/gen-perfboards

g.desc: Embedded symbols (lib PERF); generated by scripts/gen-perfboards

g.text: Main node TH PCB (hw/main, rev 2.0): 30-pin ESP32 DevKit = relays + car inputs + GPS + IMU + CAN, under-dash (D46).

g.desc: Main node TH PCB (hw/main, rev 2.0): 30-pin ESP32 DevKit = relays + car inputs + GPS + IMU + CAN, under-dash (D46).

g.text: Power: power module #2 (F1 2 A) fed from RJ45 pins 4/5 + 7/8 via J39; 3V3 into the DevKit 3V3 pin (J30).

g.desc: Power: power module #2 (F1 2 A) fed from RJ45 pins 4/5 + 7/8 via J39; 3V3 into the DevKit 3V3 pin (J30).

g.text: 3V3_SW (Q30, GPIO32 low = on) feeds CAN transceiver + GPS + MPU6050 (~60 mA), off in sleep.

g.desc: 3V3_SW (Q30, GPIO32 low = on) feeds CAN transceiver + GPS + MPU6050 (~60 mA), off in sleep.

g.text: R64 120 ohm = bus end 2 termination. U30/C35/D39 (SMD) placed by JLCPCB. GPS UART2 (GPIO16/17), MPU6050 I2C (21/22).

g.desc: R64 120 ohm = bus end 2 termination. U30/C35/D39 (SMD) placed by JLCPCB. GPS UART2 (GPIO16/17), MPU6050 I2C (21/22).

g.text: Inputs IG1/HEAD/REV (J31) via inverting NPN stages; HEAD has a 100k pull-up from COIL+.

g.desc: Inputs IG1/HEAD/REV (J31) via inverting NPN stages; HEAD has a 100k pull-up from COIL+.

g.text: Relay drivers: 4 x BC337-40 low-side + 1N4007 flyback to COIL+ (J32 in from module J3, J34 out to the relay box).

g.desc: Relay drivers: 4 x BC337-40 low-side + 1N4007 flyback to COIL+ (J32 in from module J3, J34 out to the relay box).
